John the Baptist Prepares the Way
1 In the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar—when Pontius Pilate was governor of Judea, Herod tetrarch of Galilee, his brother Philip tetrarch of Iturea and Traconitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene— 2 during the high-priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John son of Zechariah in the wilderness. 3 He went into all the country around the Jordan, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins. 4 As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet:

“A voice of one calling in the wilderness,
‘Prepare the way for the Lord,
make straight paths for him.
5 Every valley shall be filled in,
every mountain and hill made low.
The crooked roads shall become straight,
the rough ways smooth.
6 And all people will see God’s salvation.’”[a]

7 John said to the crowds coming out to be baptized by him, “You brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the coming wrath? 8 Produce fruit in keeping with repentance. And do not begin to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham. 9 The ax is already at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.”

10 “What should we do then?” the crowd asked.

11 John answered, “Anyone who has two shirts should share with the one who has none, and anyone who has food should do the same.”

12 Even tax collectors came to be baptized. “Teacher,” they asked, “what should we do?”

13 “Don’t collect any more than you are required to,” he told them.

14 Then some soldiers asked him, “And what should we do?”

He replied, “Don’t extort money and don’t accuse people falsely—be content with your pay.”

15 The people were waiting expectantly and were all wondering in their hearts if John might possibly be the Messiah. 16 John answered them all, “I baptize you with[b] water. But one who is more powerful than I will come, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie. He will baptize you with[c] the Holy Spirit and fire. 17 His winnowing fork is in his hand to clear his threshing floor and to gather the wheat into his barn, but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.” 18 And with many other words John exhorted the people and proclaimed the good news to them.

19 But when John rebuked Herod the tetrarch because of his marriage to Herodias, his brother’s wife, and all the other evil things he had done, 20 Herod added this to them all: He locked John up in prison.

The Baptism and Genealogy of Jesus
21 When all the people were being baptized, Jesus was baptized too. And as he was praying, heaven was opened 22 and the Holy Spirit descended on him in bodily form like a dove. And a voice came from heaven: “You are my Son, whom I love; with you I am well pleased.”

23 Now Jesus himself was about thirty years old when he began his ministry. He was the son, so it was thought, of Joseph,

the son of Heli, 24 the son of Matthat,

the son of Levi, the son of Melki,

the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,

25 the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos,

the son of Nahum, the son of Esli,

the son of Naggai, 26 the son of Maath,

the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein,

the son of Josek, the son of Joda,

27 the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa,

the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel,

the son of Neri, 28 the son of Melki,

the son of Addi, the son of Cosam,

the son of Elmadam, the son of Er,

29 the son of Joshua, the son of Eliezer,

the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat,

the son of Levi, 30 the son of Simeon,

the son of Judah, the son of Joseph,

the son of Jonam, the son of Eliakim,

31 the son of Melea, the son of Menna,

the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan,

the son of David, 32 the son of Jesse,

the son of Obed, the son of Boaz,

the son of Salmon,[d] the son of Nahshon,

33 the son of Amminadab, the son of Ram,[e]

the son of Hezron, the son of Perez,

the son of Judah, 34 the son of Jacob,

the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham,

the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,

35 the son of Serug, the son of Reu,

the son of Peleg, the son of Eber,

the son of Shelah, 36 the son of Cainan,

the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem,

the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,

37 the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch,

the son of Jared, the son of Mahalalel,

the son of Kenan, 38 the son of Enosh,

the son of Seth, the son of Adam,

the son of God.

浸礼会的约翰 准备前进的道路
1 在蒂比略斯·凯撒执政的十五年中——当庞蒂乌斯·彼拉多是朱迪亚的总督时,加利利的希罗德·四叉,他的兄弟菲利浦·四叉,伊图拉和特拉科尼蒂斯,以及利萨尼亚斯·四叉,阿比林的—— 2 在安娜斯和凯亚法的尊贵时期 神的旨意降临到 野外的泽迦里雅之子约翰 3 他进入约旦全国各地 宣扬忏悔的洗礼 为了宽恕罪孽 4 正如先知以赛亚所言之书所写的那样:“在荒野中呼唤的一个人的声音,`为主铺平道路,为他开辟正路。
5 各 谷 都 要 填满 、 各 山 、 各 山 、 各 下 . 弯曲 的 路 、 都 要 平坦 、 平坦 的 路
6 众人将看见真主的拯救。

7 叶哈雅对出来受洗的人群说:毒蛇的弟兄们啊!谁警告你们要逃避烈火呢? 8 你们应当为赦宥而生产果实,你们不要对自己说:我们有易卜拉欣,我们有我们的父亲。我对你们说:真主能使易卜拉欣生儿育女。 9 斧头已经是树根,不生产佳美果的每棵树都要被砍掉,然后被投入火狱。

10 群众问道:“我们应该做什么呢?”

11 他说:谁有两件衬衣,谁与谁无干,谁有饭,谁也与谁无干。

12 甚至收税者也来接受洗礼。 “老师,”他们问道,“我们该怎么办?”

13 他告诉他们, " 不要收集超过你的要求 " 。

14 有人问他:我们应该做什么呢?他说:不要勒索钱财,不要诬蔑别人,你应当满足于你的报酬。

15 人民急切地等待着 并且都在心里想 约翰是否可能是弥赛亚 16 叶哈雅对他们说:我必定要用雨水为你们施洗,但一个比我还厉害的人,我不该用他们的鞋带来施洗。他要用圣灵和火来施洗你们。 17 他手中的叉子是用来清理他的地板,把小麦放进他的谷仓,但他会用不可灭火的火烧掉这块薯片。” 18 以许多其他的话来说,约翰劝告了人民,并向他们宣布了好消息。

19 但当约翰责备希律王 因为他和希罗底斯,他哥哥的妻子 以及他做过的所有邪恶的事 20 他把约翰关在监狱里 耶稣的洗礼和恩典
21 当世人受洗的时候,耶稣也受洗了。当他祈祷的时候,天是开着的。 22 圣灵像鸽子一样附着在他身上。从天上降下声音说:你是我的儿子,我爱他,我喜悦你。

23 当耶稣开始做他的部下的时候,他大约三十岁。当时,他是一个儿子,当时,他以为他是希利的儿子约瑟。 24 他是麦尔基的儿子,麦尔基的儿子,雅奈的儿子,优素福的儿子,

25 是马 他 提 亞 的 兒 子 、 是 亞 摩 斯 的 儿 子 、 亞 摩 斯 的 子 子 、 纳 古 的 子 、 纳 古 的 子 、 以 斯 利 的 子 、 以 斯 利 的 子 、 以 斯 利 是 拿 盖 的 子 子 26 马 斯 的 兒 子 是 马 他 提 亞 的 兒 子 、 马 他 提 亞 的 兒 子 是 西 明 的 兒 子 、 西 明 的 兒 子 是 约 施 的 子 、 约 大 的 子 子
